# Chapter 11: Political Violence

## 11.1: Understanding Political Violence

::: callout-note
### Learning Objectives

By the end of this section, you will be able to:

- Define political violence and distinguish between state-sponsored violence and non-state political violence.
- Analyze the causes and dynamics of civil wars, revolutions, terrorism, and ethnic conflict.
